reason: 该插件的主要用户面向用途是可视化：在 DSH Web 会话中识别 PlantUML 代码围栏并将其渲染为 SVG 图像展示，支持流程图、时序图等图形，因此属于对话 UI 内的图表可视化增强，而非文档编辑或代码生成类能力。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，可在会话消息中自动将 PlantUML 代码围栏渲染为 SVG 图像，便于直接查看图表内容。
summaries.en: This is a DSH web plugin that automatically renders PlantUML fenced blocks in chat messages into SVG diagrams for easier inline viewing.

capabilities: Render PlantUML fenced code blocks from assistant messages into inline SVG output.
Send PlantUML source to a configurable remote PlantUML service for rendering.
Optionally invoke a locally configured PlantUML executable for rendering.

reasons.code: Conversation renderer parses ```plantuml/```puml blocks and replaces them with SVG in message display.
Plugin exposes POST /plugin/plantuml and uses default PlantUML service URL, indicating network-based rendering path.
Configuration allows DSH_PLANTUML_COMMAND to run a local plantuml command instead of remote rendering.
